_comment: PROTOTYPE / EXPERIMENTAL configuration. Model names are configurable here or via env vars GEMINI_MODEL, GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODELS, GROQ_MODEL, EMBEDDING_MODEL. Never put API keys in this file.

gemini._selection_note: gemini-3.8-flash measured 1/15 successful calls (8x 503 UNAVAILABLE, 6x 429) in the 2026-09-25 smoke test; gemini-3.1-flash-lite (GA) used for a consistent single-model experiment. No silent fallback: a different model would confound the comparison.

groq._selection_note: openai/gpt-oss-120b: different model family from Gemini (independence), supports strict json_schema on Groq.

anthropic._selection_note: OPTIONAL third-provider experiment arm (python -m src.prototype.run_extraction --provider anthropic). Key only via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env. No temperature parameter (rejected by this model); thinking is adaptive by default and effort is set explicitly. No refusal fallback model: a different model answering would confound the comparison. Override the model with ANTHROPIC_MODEL.

embedding._selection_note: Measured 2026-09-25: gemini-embedding-001 (768-d) returned 429 after 5 batches (~500 texts) on this key, making ~33k reference texts infeasible. Local ONNX model via fastembed: bge-small-en-v1.5 87 texts/s vs bge-base-en-v1.5 21 texts/s on this CPU. Gemini path kept: set provider='gemini', model='gemini-embedding-001', dimensions=768.

alignment._comment: Task -> O*NET alignment (src.prototype.alignment tasks). Cosine thresholds for local bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings. PROVISIONAL (2026-10-08): set from a manual spot check of 28 top-1 pairs across similarity bands (0.80-0.83 mostly wrong, >=0.86 mostly plausible but generic). Not calibrated - no human O*NET mapping labels exist yet.

evaluation._comment: Task evaluation matcher (src.prototype.task_eval). Thresholds are configurable on the CLI.
